name: Minion!
source:
Serve as a minion to a powerful sorceress queen. Your decisions will cause the kingdom to flourish - or be destroyed!
[From [url=https://mutive.itch.io/minion] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为强大的女巫女王效力，成为她的爪牙。你的决定会让王国繁荣——或走向毁灭！

（来源：[url=https://mutive.itch.io/minion]itch.io[/url]）
